topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes and assays for cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the historical study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to test transforming capability.

topics.label: Functional classification and genetic mechanisms of cancer mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the distinctions between oncogenes and tumor suppressors, exploring their pathways and allele-specific mutation dynamics.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the repair, replication, and mitotic defects that drive sequence and chromosomal instability and their resulting cellular stress phenotypes.

topics.label: Multi-step progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the accumulation of mutations over time and inherited genetic defects drive multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with closing remarks, recommended reading, and a look ahead to the next session.
